verses.text: As dead flies bring a stench to the perfumer’s oil, so a little folly outweighs wisdom and honor.

verses.text: A wise man’s heart inclines to the right, but the heart of a fool to the left.

verses.text: Even as the fool walks along the road, his sense is lacking, and he shows everyone that he is a fool.

verses.text: If the ruler’s temper flares against you, do not abandon your post, for calmness lays great offenses to rest.

verses.text: There is an evil I have seen under the sun—an error that proceeds from the ruler:

verses.text: He who digs a pit may fall into it, and he who breaches a wall may be bitten by a snake.

verses.text: If the axe is dull and the blade unsharpened, more strength must be exerted, but skill produces success.

verses.text: The words of a wise man’s mouth are gracious, but the lips of a fool consume him.

verses.text: Yet the fool multiplies words. No one knows what is coming, and who can tell him what will come after him?

verses.text: Woe to you, O land whose king is a youth, and whose princes feast in the morning.
